title: Iris
description: Nine black anodised aperture blades over a grainy night photograph shot on film: a parked car, two people on the sand and a lamp burning through the fog. Turn the ring from f/1.4 to f/16 and the lamps fall from nine-sided bokeh discs into 18-point stars, every stop clicks into its detent and the blades swish as they close.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: a real nine-blade iris whose opening is the shape of every bokeh disc and the source of every diffraction star, over a real film photograph, with the foley of a manual lens ring.
sources: Photograph: Herb's own film photo, public/scorch/beams.webp (used with permission, all rights Herb)
